name: expectation-example
command: import fs from "node:fs"; import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import {expectationSchema} from "./src/config.ts"; import {workmeshSkillManifest} from "@workmesh/contracts"; const e=expectationSchema.parse(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("examples/expectation.json","utf8"))); assert.deepEqual(e.skill, workmeshSkillManifest); console.log("清单样例 schema 与真实 Skill pin 一致");
